moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 上方各规则每个序列的最新状态，按您可以读取的范围。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The report is rendered as you and sent by email. Other people receive it only when they may read exactly what you read; each gets a message of their own.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 报表按您的身份生成，并通过电子邮件发送。其他人只有在能读取与您完全相同的内容时才会收到；每人收到自己的一封。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The rows you see here, up to ${viewed.exportCapText}; the export is recorded.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您在此看到的行，上限为 ${viewed.exportCapText}；导出会被记录。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The selected alerts are not evaluated and tell nobody until activated again. Each one's result is shown.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 所选告警在再次启用之前不会评估，也不会通知任何人。每一项的结果都会显示。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The selected schedules send nothing until resumed. Each one's result is shown.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 所选排程在继续之前不会发送任何内容。每一项的结果都会显示。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The state of each series as its owner reads it. No data and Error mean the health is not known, never Normal.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每个序列的状态按其所有者的读取结果。无数据和 Error 表示健康状况未知，绝不是 Normal。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The telemetry indexes, the DataDocument indexes and saved dataset definitions with their row filters. Queries run with your dataset permissions.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 遥测索引、DataDocument 索引，以及带有行筛选的已保存数据集定义。查询按您的数据集权限运行。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This alert does not exist or is not shared with you.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此告警不存在，或未与您共享。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This definition is not a saved search
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此定义不是已保存的搜索

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This definition is not a shared alert item of that type
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此定义不是该类型的共享告警项

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This definition is not a shared contact point, silence or mute timing
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此定义不是共享联系点、静默或静音时段

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This delivery does not exist or is not yours to see.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此投递不存在，或不属于您查看。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This entry is unavailable in the authorized dataset and time range.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此条目在已授权的数据集和时间范围内不可用。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This is a production instance. Changes made here are changes to live data.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这是一个生产实例。在这里所做的更改就是对正在使用的数据的更改。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This is the report as you read it now. Every recipient is checked to read the same before each delivery.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这是您当前读取到的报表。每次投递前都会检查每位收件人读取的内容是否相同。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This schedule does not exist or is not yours.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此排程不存在，或不属于您。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Type a part of the name; choosing one opens it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 输入名称的一部分；选中一项即打开

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Type a part of the name; choosing one opens its detail, which has Run
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 输入名称的一部分；选中一项即打开其详情，其中有运行
报表预览的内容类型不符合预期

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Unique in the dataset; the last part of the path by default
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 在数据集内唯一；默认使用路径的最后一段
未知的共享告警项类型

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Use ISO times including Z or an explicit UTC offset
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 使用 ISO 时间，并包含 Z 或明确的 UTC 偏移

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Vacuum full: rewrites the table, locked meanwhile
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: Vacuum full：重写该表，期间处于锁定

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Verify the certificate (needs the root certificate file)
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 验证证书（需要根证书文件）

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What opens: the entity's records in the data grid, or its definition
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 打开的内容：数据表格中该实体的记录，或其定义

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Whether ${recipientName} received this message is not known. Check with them or the mail system, then record what happened; only then can it be sent again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 尚不知道 ${recipientName} 是否收到此消息。请向对方或邮件系统核实，再记录发生的情况；只有这样才可以再次发送。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You no longer read this report, so it cannot be delivered.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您已不能读取此报表，因此无法投递。
